candidates.name: Dextrocardia

candidates.why: The patient's heart is located on the right side of the chest, which is a characteristic of dextrocardia.

candidates.name: Situs Inversus

candidates.why: The patient's liver is located on the left side, and the heart is also reversed, which are characteristics of situs inversus.
